news.titleEn: Nvidia stock closes down over 4% after CEO Jensen Huang announces resignation
news.conclusionEn: Jensen Huang resigned as Nvidia's CEO and board member with immediate effect; CFO Colette Kress is interim CEO and the stock closed down 4.34% after falling as much as 14%.
news.conclusionZh: 黄仁勋辞去英伟达CEO，CFO克雷斯暂代，股价收跌4.34%
news.whyEn: Nvidia is the AI trade's bellwether and a top weight in global indexes; losing its founder-CEO adds uncertainty for chip supply chains, AI spending and index funds.
news.whyZh: 英伟达是AI行情风向标和指数重仓股，创始人离任冲击芯片链与指数基金
news.detailEn: Huang, who led Nvidia since founding it in 1993, stepped down after reports of extramarital affairs, including one with a Megaspeed executive whom U.S. intelligence reportedly believes is a Chinese spy and one with a company VP who reported to him. The board named former Synopsys CEO Harvey C. Jones as its first-ever chair and will search internal and external CEO candidates. Shares recovered from a 14% intraday plunge but still hit a 52-week low on very heavy volume. Nvidia reports quarterly results on Nov. 17, which will be the first test of investor confidence in the new leadership.
news.detailZh: 黄仁勋自1993年创立英伟达起一直掌舵，此次因多段婚外情曝光而辞职，其中一名Megaspeed高管据报被美国情报部门怀疑是中国间谍，另一人是向他汇报的公司副总裁。董事会任命前Synopsys CEO哈维·琼斯为首任董事长，并将从内部和外部物色正式CEO。股价盘中一度暴跌14%后收窄跌幅，但仍创52周新低，成交量异常放大。英伟达将于11月17日公布季报，这是市场对新管理层信心的第一次检验。

news.titleEn: Oil prices rise after Trump says no Iran deal needed: 'We've got their Strait'
news.conclusionEn: Brent jumped 3.3% to $95.82 and WTI rose 2.6% to $88.74 after Trump posted that the U.S. does not need a deal with Iran.
news.conclusionZh: 特朗普称无需与伊朗达成协议，布油涨3.3%至95.82美元
news.whyEn: The remark dents hopes of a quick end to the U.S.-Iran conflict and a full reopening of the Strait of Hormuz, keeping energy and inflation risks elevated worldwide.
news.whyZh: 打压美伊冲突速结和霍尔木兹海峡重开的预期，全球能源与通胀风险仍高
news.detailEn: Oil had tumbled in November — WTI down 16% and Brent down 20% month to date — as traders priced in a settlement. Analysts say neither side's position has changed: Iran wants the blockade lifted and sanctions eased, while the U.S. wants Iran to give up its nuclear stockpile and allow free passage through Hormuz. Some warn Trump's claim of control over the Strait could provoke more attacks on shipping. Others argue new Middle East supply will cap near-term prices, though insurance and tanker costs keep longer-dated futures high.
news.detailZh: 此前市场押注和谈，11月以来WTI累计跌16%、布油跌20%。分析师指出双方立场并未改变：伊朗要求解除封锁和放松制裁，美国要求伊朗交出核材料并保障海峡自由通行。有人担心特朗普声称「控制了海峡」会招致更多针对油轮的袭击。也有分析认为中东新增供应会压住近期油价，但保险和油轮成本让远期合约价格居高不下。

news.titleEn: Nasdaq Composite slides as Nvidia shares tumble on Jensen Huang's exit; oil prices jump
news.conclusionEn: U.S. stocks closed slightly lower on Thursday — S&P 500 -0.35%, Nasdaq -0.39%, Dow -0.36% — as Nvidia fell while rivals AMD and Broadcom rallied over 5%.
news.conclusionZh: 美股周四小幅收跌，英伟达拖累大盘，AMD和博通大涨超5%
news.whyEn: Money rotating from Nvidia into rival chipmakers shows investors reassessing AI leadership, while a weak small-cap session signals worry about rates and oil.
news.whyZh: 资金从英伟达转向竞争对手，反映市场重估AI格局，小盘股疲软显示利率担忧
news.detailEn: The S&P 500 erased an early drop of nearly 1% to close at 7,592.40, while the small-cap Russell 2000 fell about 1.7%. Apple hit a record intraday high, and analysts said AMD and Broadcom could gain share if Nvidia stumbles. Weekly jobless claims rose to 200,000, slightly above forecasts but still low. Cleveland Fed President Beth Hammack reiterated support for gradual rate hikes, keeping a December Fed increase firmly in play.
news.detailZh: 标普500盘中一度跌近1%，最终收于7592.40点；小盘股罗素2000跌约1.7%。苹果盘中创历史新高，分析师认为英伟达若受挫，AMD和博通有望抢占份额。上周首次申领失业金人数升至20万，略高于预期但仍处低位。克利夫兰联储主席哈马克重申支持渐进加息，12月加息的可能性依然很高。

news.titleEn: Jensen Huang's Nvidia exit casts shadow over Wall Street's $500 billion AI financing bet
news.conclusionEn: Huang's exit clouds Nvidia's preliminary plan with Apollo, BlackRock, Blackstone, Brookfield, Goldman Sachs and KKR to mobilize over $500 billion for AI infrastructure.
news.conclusionZh: 黄仁勋离任为英伟达牵头的5000亿美元AI融资计划蒙上阴影
news.whyEn: The deals would use Nvidia chips as collateral; any repricing of risk could raise borrowing costs for data centers and slow the AI build-out.
news.whyZh: 该计划以英伟达芯片作抵押，风险重估会推高数据中心融资成本
news.detailEn: In August Nvidia signed non-binding memorandums with six major investment firms to fund data centers and chip plants through specialized vehicles backed by its AI chips, similar to real-estate or toll-road securitizations. The arrangements still need final agreements. Analysts say lenders may demand higher returns for the added uncertainty but are unlikely to walk away. One strategist called it 'not a financing crisis yet', though it could trigger a broader repricing of AI risk.
news.detailZh: 今年8月，英伟达与六家大型投资机构签署非约束性备忘录，计划通过以其AI芯片为抵押的专门融资工具，为数据中心和芯片工厂筹资，结构类似房地产或收费公路的资产证券化。这些安排仍需签署正式协议。分析师认为，出资方可能要求更高回报来补偿不确定性，但不太会退出。有策略师称「目前还不是融资危机」，但可能引发市场对AI风险的整体重新定价。

news.titleEn: 'Punch in the gut': Homes sales fall to their lowest in 16 years
news.conclusionEn: U.S. existing-home sales fell 5.5% in October to a 3.75 million annual pace, the lowest since August 2010, as mortgage rates topped 7%.
news.conclusionZh: 美国10月成屋销售降至2010年以来最低，房贷利率超7%
news.whyEn: Housing is a key channel for Fed tightening; a frozen market hits builders, brokers, banks and consumer spending, and shows how high rates are biting the real economy.
news.whyZh: 楼市冻结波及建筑、中介、银行和消费，显示高利率正冲击实体经济
news.detailEn: Sales were 8.8% lower than a year earlier, according to the National Association of Realtors. The average 30-year fixed mortgage rate averaged about 7.3% in October, among the highest since 2000. Even so, the median price edged up 0.4% to $416,700, its 40th straight annual gain, because inventory remains tight. Economists now expect full-year 2026 sales to be the weakest since 1995, and further Fed hikes could deepen the slump.
news.detailZh: 据全美房地产经纪人协会数据，销量同比下降8.8%。10月30年期固定房贷利率平均约7.3%，处于2000年以来最高水平之一。由于库存仍然紧张，房价中位数仍小幅上涨0.4%至41.67万美元，连续40个月同比上涨。经济学家预计2026年全年销量将是1995年以来最低，若美联储继续加息，楼市低迷可能进一步加深。

news.titleEn: Stock futures rise after market dips amid Nvidia woes: Live updates
news.conclusionEn: U.S. stock futures rose and Asian chip stocks rebounded on Friday, with South Korea's Kospi up as much as 2.8% at the open, while the yen weakened past 160 per dollar.
news.conclusionZh: 周五美股期货上涨，韩股开盘涨近2.8%，日元跌破160
news.whyEn: The rebound suggests markets see Nvidia's turmoil as company-specific, while a yen past 160 raises the risk of Japanese currency intervention.
news.whyZh: 市场视英伟达风波为个股事件；日元破160加大日本干预汇市的风险
news.detailEn: Nasdaq-100 futures gained about 0.6% Thursday evening, and all three major U.S. indexes were on track for their best week since early August. In Asia, Samsung and SK Hynix led a chip rally in Seoul and Japan's Nikkei rose more than 1%, while Hong Kong and mainland China dipped. Japan's finance minister signaled possible action after the yen crossed 160 per dollar. Investors now await October U.S. producer price data, expected to show a 0.4% monthly rise.
news.detailZh: 周四晚间纳指100期货上涨约0.6%，美股三大指数有望录得8月初以来最佳单周表现。亚洲方面，三星电子和SK海力士领涨首尔芯片股，日经指数涨超1%，港股和A股小幅下跌。日元跌破1美元兑160日元后，日本财务大臣暗示可能出手干预。投资者接下来关注美国10月PPI数据，预计环比上涨0.4%。

news.titleEn: Trump threatens to double tariffs on Mexico over migrant caravans
news.conclusionEn: Trump said tariffs on Mexico will be 'immediately doubled' unless it stops migrant caravans heading north toward the U.S.
news.conclusionZh: 特朗普威胁若墨西哥不拦截移民车队，立即将关税翻倍
news.whyEn: Mexico is America's largest trading partner; higher tariffs would hit autos, steel and cross-border supply chains and complicate ongoing U.S.-Mexico trade talks.
news.whyZh: 墨西哥是美国最大贸易伙伴，加税将冲击汽车、钢铁和跨境供应链
news.detailEn: Trump posted the threat on Truth Social, linking the caravans to Republican losses in last week's midterm elections and calling the situation an 'INVASION'. Mexican President Claudia Sheinbaum confirmed two caravans are moving through southern Mexico but said one shrank from about 600 to roughly 100 people after Mexican intervention, and that no caravan has reached the northern border since Trump returned to office. The State Department had already imposed visa restrictions on alleged caravan organizers. Markets will watch whether the threat becomes formal policy and how it affects trade negotiations.
news.detailZh: 特朗普在Truth Social上发帖提出威胁，并将移民车队与共和党在上周中期选举中的失利联系起来，称之为「入侵」。墨西哥总统辛鲍姆证实有两支车队正在墨南部行进，但表示其中一支经干预后已从约600人减至约100人，且特朗普重新执政以来没有车队抵达北部边境。美国国务院此前已对涉嫌组织车队的人实施签证限制。市场将关注这一威胁是否会变成正式政策，以及对美墨贸易谈判的影响。

news.titleEn: U.S. brokers another Russia-Ukraine prisoner swap, but war continues as Putin sticks to demand for territory
news.conclusionEn: U.S.-mediated talks in Abu Dhabi produced a large Russia-Ukraine prisoner swap deal but no breakthrough, and U.S. envoys then met Putin in Moscow.
news.conclusionZh: 美国斡旋俄乌达成大规模换俘，但领土问题仍无突破
news.whyEn: Any path to a ceasefire would reshape European security, energy markets and defense spending; the lack of progress on territory means the war and sanctions likely persist.
news.whyZh: 停火进展关系欧洲安全、能源和军费，领土僵局意味战争与制裁延续
news.detailEn: It was the first meeting between the two delegations in nine months, and Jared Kushner called the swap 'the biggest humanitarian release of prisoners', with final numbers still being set. Russia still wants its seizure of much of eastern Ukraine recognized, while Zelenskyy has rejected territorial concessions in exchange for security guarantees short of NATO membership. Envoys Kushner and Steve Witkoff were due to brief Putin in Moscow on Thursday before meeting Zelenskyy in Dublin. Fighting and overnight strikes continue on both sides.
news.detailZh: 这是双方代表团九个月来首次会面，库什纳称此次换俘是「规模最大的人道主义释放」，具体人数仍在敲定。俄罗斯仍要求承认其占领的乌克兰东部大片领土，泽连斯基则拒绝以领土让步换取不包括加入北约的安全保障。特使库什纳和威特科夫周四在莫斯科会见普京，之后将赴都柏林会见泽连斯基。双方的战斗和夜间空袭仍在继续。

businessTips.explanationEn: Succession planning is the deliberate process of identifying and developing people who can step into critical roles, especially the CEO, if the incumbent leaves suddenly. Good plans name an emergency interim leader, a shortlist of long-term candidates, and a timeline for each. It protects continuity, reassures investors and employees, and prevents a power vacuum during a crisis.
businessTips.explanationZh: 继任计划是有意识地识别并培养能够接手关键岗位（尤其是CEO）的人选，以防现任者突然离开。好的计划会明确紧急情况下的临时负责人、长期候选人名单以及各自的时间表。它能保障经营连续性，稳定投资者和员工信心，避免危机中出现权力真空。
businessTips.exampleEn: When Nvidia's CEO resigned abruptly, the board could immediately name the CFO as interim CEO and appoint an independent chair, while launching a formal search. Even a five-person business can apply this: write down who can approve payments, talk to key clients and access systems if the owner is out for a month.
businessTips.exampleZh: 英伟达CEO突然辞职时，董事会能立即任命CFO为临时CEO、设立独立董事长，并启动正式遴选。即便是五个人的小公司也可以照做：写清楚如果老板一个月不在，谁能批付款、对接核心客户、登录关键系统。

businessTips.explanationEn: Pre-selling means taking orders or deposits for a product or service before it fully exists. It is the strongest form of market validation, because people paying money is far more reliable than people saying they are interested. It also funds early production and reduces the risk of building something nobody wants.
businessTips.explanationZh: 预售是指在产品或服务完全做出来之前就先收订单或定金。它是最有力的市场验证方式，因为愿意掏钱远比口头说「感兴趣」可靠。预售还能为早期生产提供资金，降低做出没人要的东西的风险。
businessTips.exampleEn: Before filming a full online course, a creator posts an outline and offers 30 early-bird spots at a discount; if fewer than 10 sell, they refund buyers and rethink the topic. A baker can take pre-orders for holiday gift boxes to know exactly how many ingredients to buy.
businessTips.exampleZh: 一位博主在录制整套网课前，先发布课程大纲并以优惠价开放30个早鸟名额，如果卖出不到10个就退款并重新考虑选题。烘焙副业也可以先接节日礼盒预订，按订单量精确采购原料。

businessTips.explanationEn: Securitization pools income-producing or valuable assets — such as mortgages, car loans, or even equipment like AI chips — into a separate vehicle that issues bonds backed by those assets. Investors are repaid from the assets' cash flows rather than the parent company's general credit. It lets companies raise large amounts of capital more cheaply, but risk can be mispriced if the collateral's value or cash flow is uncertain.
businessTips.explanationZh: 资产证券化是把能产生现金流或有价值的资产（如房贷、车贷，甚至AI芯片等设备）打包放进一个独立实体，并以这些资产为支撑发行债券。投资者靠这些资产的现金流获得偿付，而不是依赖母公司的整体信用。这能让企业以更低成本融到大量资金，但如果抵押物的价值或现金流不确定，风险就可能被错误定价。
businessTips.exampleEn: Nvidia's planned $500 billion AI financing would use its chips as collateral, similar to toll-road securitizations. If chip values drop faster than expected, or confidence in the issuer weakens, lenders demand higher yields, which is why leadership turmoil can raise the cost of such deals.
businessTips.exampleZh: 英伟达计划中的5000亿美元AI融资就是以芯片作为抵押，类似收费公路证券化。如果芯片贬值快于预期，或市场对发起方信心下降，出资方就会要求更高收益率，这就是管理层动荡会推高此类融资成本的原因。
